svg.title: Veil, stage 2 device concept
svg.desc: Schematic drawing of a possible handheld Veil device: front, side and exploded views of the shuffled keypad screen, digit pad, share card slot, tamper mesh, chaotic PUF, RISC-V core, noise source and zeroize cell.
svg.text: Twelve keys. What you press says nothing
One share at a time. No radio, no network
Cut or short it and the device forgets
The device factor, read from the silicon
veil-core on bare metal, no unsafe code
Keeps the wipe armed with power off
THE SECRET IS NEVER WHOLE, ANYWHERE
